After uninstalling HyperCeiler, the module configuration remains in the Xposed framework database. To remove it completely, first go to the module settings and reset the module configuration, then uninstall.

HyperCeiler hasn\'t read the current framework information from XposedService yet, so compatibility can\'t be confirmed for now.
Why does the homepage show a warning?

The homepage warning only appears when HyperCeiler detects that the current framework doesn\'t meet the minimum runtime requirements, or XposedService can\'t return framework information normally. To avoid instability caused by abnormal Hook loading, HyperCeiler will stop loading Hook at the same time.
